current_game.title: Skyball
current_game.concept: In Skyball, players control a ball that can bounce and roll through a futuristic city, collecting power-ups and avoiding obstacles while trying to reach the exit before time runs out. The twist? The ball can transform into a variety of objects, each with its own abilities and weaknesses.
current_game.inspiration: Portal (for its puzzle-solving elements) and Super Mario Galaxy (for its creative level design)
